newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates stable on central bank issue.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates stable on central bank issue.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates stabilised at mid-session on Tuesday after the central bank announced it would issue T$10 billion in negotiable certificates of deposit later in the day to mop up excess funds, dealers said.
The overnight interbank rate was at 5.050 percent against Monday's 5.053 close, with 30-day commercial paper unchanged at 5.10-5.15 percent.
Dealers said the central bank issue would have only temporary effect and expected rates to resume a downtrend.
In the bond market, the 10-year 86/4 bond yield was at 6.2450 against 6.2800-6.2750. -- Rachel Lee (5080815)
